summary: Shinhan Financial Group's board resolved on July 23, 2026, to acquire up to 6,698,564 common shares (approx. KRW 700 billion) via KRX open-market purchases from July 31 to October 22, 2026. The share buyback is part of the 2026 Corporate Value-Up Plan to enhance shareholder return and increase corporate value through cancellation of all repurchased shares. The repurchase is funded from profits available for dividends (KRW 4,125 billion upper limit) and is executed through Shinhan Securities. The daily purchase limit is the lower of 10% of shares to be acquired, 25% of one-month average daily volume, or 1% of shares outstanding. Watch for potential additional repurchases later in 2026 and final cancellation timeline under the Korean Commercial Act's one-year cancellation rule.
